meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把创意、链接或设计稿变成带字幕动效的视频成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字创意、网址或设计稿快速做成带动画的视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a brief, link, or design into a finished animated video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn ideas, links, or designs into animated videos.

howto.what: Claude 会把视频、动画、动效图的请求当成统一入口处理:先读项目状态,新需求走意图访谈并写出 BRIEF.md,再选装对应工作流,用 HTML 合成来渲染视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作、编辑或渲染视频、动画,或要检查、预览、发布已有的 HyperFrames 项目时会先接管。若你只要录制浏览器会话,或明确指定别的框架,则不走它。

say.text: 帮我把这个网站做成一条宣传视频
say.note: 先问清视频主题,再路由到对应工作流。

say.text: 给这段口播素材加字幕,不要改原片
检查并预览我现有的 HyperFrames 项目
say.note: 只执行该操作,跳过意图访谈。

howto.what_en: Claude treats video, animation and motion-graphic requests as a single entry point: it reads project state, runs an intent interview for new work, writes BRIEF.md, installs the matching workflow, and renders video from HTML compositions.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to make, edit or render a video or animation, or to inspect, preview or publish an existing HyperFrames project. Skipped for browser-session recording or a different framework.

say_en.text: Turn this website into a promo video
say_en.note: Asks about the subject, then routes to a workflow.

say_en.text: Add captions to this talking-head footage without changing it
Check and preview my existing HyperFrames project
say_en.note: Runs only that operation, skipping the interview.
